faq.q1q: What is the difference between an iad advisor and a real estate agency?
faq.q1a: An independent iad advisor is a professional attached to SAS I@D France. They offer the same services as an agency (valuation, sale, purchase) with often lower fees thanks to reduced overhead.
faq.q2q: How much does a property valuation cost in Provence Verte and Haut-Var?
faq.q2a: The valuation is entirely free and without commitment. It is based on real recent sale prices in your area and on-the-ground knowledge of Provence Verte and Haut-Var.
faq.q3q: Which towns do you cover in Provence Verte and Haut-Var?
faq.q3a: I cover the entire Provence Verte and Haut-Var region: Barjols, Montmeyan, Quinson, Fox-Amphoux, Tavernes, Rians, Aups, Salernes, Ginasservis, Varages, Esparron-de-Verdon, Artignosc-sur-Verdon and all neighboring towns.
faq.q4q: How long does it take to sell a property in Provence Verte?
faq.q4a: The average selling time depends on the property and its price positioning. With a fair valuation and an adapted distribution strategy, most properties in Provence Verte and Haut-Var find a buyer in 4 to 12 weeks.
faq.q5q: What is the express property audit?
faq.q5a: It's a free review of your property done in a few minutes. It identifies areas to watch — legal, technical, environmental — so you can sell or buy with full awareness.
